fields.subject: ShardsValues
fields.where: the invoked overload is one of the two List<> forms whose records parameter is one key-component narrower than its own generic type parameters: ShardListForeign<TRecord, TChild>(short shardId, List<ShardKey<TRecord>> records) at ShardsValues.cs line 255, or ShardListForeign<TRecord, TChild, TGrandChild>(short shardId, List<ShardKey<TRecord>> records) at line 324
fields.condition: the records argument is non-null and its actual runtime type does not itself implement the wider IList<ShardKey<TRecord, TChild>> (or, for the three-level overload, IList<ShardKey<TRecord, TChild, TGrandChild>>) interface the forwarding cast targets — guaranteed true for any plain List<ShardKey<TRecord>> instance, since List<T> implements IList<T> only for its own exact closed type and ShardKey<TRecord> is necessarily a different closed generic type from the wider ShardKey forms regardless of ShardKey's own member definitions, but not guaranteed for a caller-supplied subclass of List<ShardKey<TRecord>> that separately implements the wider interface, in which case the cast succeeds instead and execution forwards normally into the IList<> overload at line 265 or line 337
fields.response: throw a System.InvalidCastException at its own forwarding cast, because the argument's runtime type does not implement the wider interface the cast targets
fields.postcondition: the forwarded overload at line 265 or line 337 is never reached, and no ShardsValues is returned
